terms.meaning: a land survey document that states a recorded area and holder

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the services it combines
sections.what: Brings in the case, document, shape, area comparison, geospatial and area reading services that this file gathers together.
sections.why: Likely reason: this file combines specialist services, so it depends on each of them.

sections.name: ParcelIntelligenceService, parcelIntelligenceService
sections.title: Gathers and compares parcel data
sections.what: Builds the parcel view for a case: the first parcel, its shape, the historical and survey documents and their stated values, the calculated area, three labelled area sources and the comparison verdict. Returns nothing when the case or parcel is missing.
sections.why: Likely reason: the parcel view needs one complete answer, and missing pieces are labelled rather than hidden.
sections.watch_out: Document matching depends on identifiers ending in a known name or on the document kind, so renamed documents may not be found.

summary: Gathers what the app knows about one case's parcel in one place: its boundary, recorded areas and how they compare.
purpose: Feeds the parcel view with the three area sources and the overall verdict.
why: Likely reason: the parcel view needs one call that returns the full picture, rather than loading each piece separately.
how: Finds the case and its first land parcel, then loads the parcel shape and the case documents. It picks the historical and survey documents, reads their stated acre values, calculates the area from the shape and builds three labelled sources. It then runs the comparison and returns the parcel details, shape, calculated area, recorded values and verdict. It returns nothing if the case or parcel is missing.
outputs: A parcel intelligence object, or nothing.
risks: Only the first parcel of a case is used. Missing sources are labelled unavailable rather than causing a failure.
debug: If a source shows unavailable, check the document title and the Area line format. If the calculated area is missing, check the stored shape row for the case.
